messages:
sanjay: Quick kickoff: CloudVista asked for a compact marketplace-ready refarch + terraform module + tiny sample app. GA goal ~3 weeks. Who owns module, sample app, CI/publish, security checklist?

anya: I can own the Terraform module + variable schema. Need sec to confirm KMS/network constraints.

kate: I'll build the sample app and README. Prefer a small container image + quickstart script.

mike: Agreed on container image. CI should build multi-arch (x86 + arm) and push digests. Add Dockerfile notes for quantized runtimes.

oliver: Module surface: vpc, subnets, sg, autoscaling group for inference nodes, iam role for model fetch. Outputs: endpoint_url, alb_dns. Keep inputs minimal.

anya: Usage snippet: module "cloudvista_inference" { source = "github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace/cloudvista-inference-module" region = var.region instance_type = var.instance_type model_repo = "cloudvista/gpt-serve" }

kate: Sample app should show two modes: (1) private local endpoint, (2) hosted fallback to Redwood API. Node + curl examples.

mike: I'll wire CI matrix and publish workflow. Recommend m6a for Ampere, g5 as GPU option.

sanjay: Timeline: wk0 scaffold+CI; wk1 sample+multi-arch builds; wk2 partner review+security audit; wk3 finalize marketplace package + SBOM. Volunteers: @anya @kate @mike @oliver?

anya: Module scaffold by Tue.

kate: Sample prototype by Thu.

mike: CI + publish by Wed.

oliver: Security checklist & KMS notes by Fri.

cloud_partner_bot: Marketplace checklist: signed SBOM, minimal e2e smoke test (health + inference), CLA for samples. Created issue #682.

Mira (CloudVista): Confirmed registry perms via DM. I'll drop partner constraints doc in shared drive and tag this thread.

mike: Will push staging images once constraints + registry are live and share digests.

anya: I'll add CHANGELOG + semver policy to repo.

kate: README sections: quickstart, deploy (container+terraform), local dev, troubleshooting.

oliver: Include a tiny smoke test that hits /health and runs a sample inference request to satisfy e2e.

sanjay: Great. Next sync Fri 10am PT. If registry perms arrive earlier we can accelerate. I'll create a short project board after this message.
